text:
maria (partnerships): Hey team — kicking off a joint cross-stack performance protocol with ArborCompute. Goal: measure throughput, perf/W, and kernel tunables across our two serving SKUs (rdx-7b and rdx-13b). Need alignment on telemetry schema, harness, and schedule. cc @kevin_ArborCompute :wave:

Tom (perf-eng): What's the target seq-length mix and QPS targets for smoke vs production runs? Also will we run quantized variants?

emily (eng-runtime): For kernel tuning we'll want per-op timings, kernel occupancy, and power sampled at ~10Hz. Proposed runtime flags to start with: --kv-cache=on --batcher=dynamic --quantize=auto. Minimal repro job for lab:

```bash
rw-bench run --model rdx-7b --seq 1024 --qps 50 --duration 30m --telemetry telemetry_schema_v1.json
```

kevin @ArborCompute: We can provide PMBus traces + per-card temperature logs and an inline probe kit. Available week of Apr 6. We can also share our card-level power curve CSVs.

rahul (infra): Reserved lab-rack-3 Apr 6-9 for the runs. Images: rdx-lab-2026-04-01 (bios defaults: C-state disabled, turbo on). I put the infra runbook here: https://internal.redwood/infra/runbooks/partnerships-arborcompute (note: internal link).

ops-bot: Calendar invite created: "ArborCompute x Redwood — Cross-stack perf protocol kickoff" Apr 7 10:00 PT. Attendees: maria, tom, emily, rahul, kevin_Arbor.

maria (partnerships): Great — action items:
- emily: finalize telemetry_schema_v1.json (include pmbus, host-power, kernel-callstack sampling)
- tom: draft workload matrix (seq distribution, batch sizes, QPS per SKU, quantized vs fp16)
- rahul: confirm host images and verify PSU/probe install window
- kevin: share PMBus schema + probe kit ETA + any recommended firmware settings

Please ack when you have visibility :thumbsup:

Tom (perf-eng): ack. I'll upload the workload matrix by EOD Friday.

emily (eng-runtime): ack. I'll open a PR with telemetry schema and a small harness script.

kevin @ArborCompute: ack — kit ETA EOD Tue, will include probe wiring diagram and CSV power curves.

maria (partnerships): Also will coordinate a short joint comms blurb for the marketplace listing post validation. Keeping this thread as the quick-status channel.

Tom (perf-eng): one Q — do we want to include a perf/W normalized to baseline kernel (our default kernel set) or report raw? my suggestion: both, with an annotation of kernel flags used.

maria (partnerships): both please, and include exact kernel flags and git commit for reproducibility.

rahul (infra): noted. I'll snapshot bios and host kernel package and put artifacts under s3://redwood-perf/arbor/1719054321/

maria (partnerships): perfect, thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after initial smoke runs.

ops-bot: Reminder set for Apr 6 09:00 PT — "Lab prep: ArborCompute probe install"

kevin @ArborCompute: thanks — looking forward.

maria (partnerships): closing loop for now.
